scope: beta.19 read-only native-start trace and pinned-source review

findings: Android emits fixed markers around libbox service start and default-network callback updates; installed beta.19 emitted none because the service was not started after installation.
Amnezia Box serializes wrapper Start, BindUpdate, and Close with its access mutex; AmneziaWG serializes BindUpdate and Close with its network mutex.

A default-interface callback can reach BindUpdate when the selected interface changes. The beta.18 crash-PC symbolization is consistent with this path, but does not identify the trigger or prove a source defect.

The monitor source writes isExpensive and isConstrained outside defaultInterfaceAccess; this is a concurrency-review concern, but no evidence ties it to the observed SIGABRT, so it was not changed or promoted to a root cause.

remaining_evidence_needed: fixed beta.19 service-start and callback trace from a bounded physical diagnostic start
